follow-up time: Not specified, but data was collected through user questionnaires
exposure: use of the Tat app for pelvic floor muscle training
cohort: Pregnant and postnatal women in Sweden who used the Tat app.
finding: Regular pelvic floor muscle training and app use were associated with improvement in urinary incontinence symptoms, particularly in pregnant women who used the app at least once per week and postnatal women with more severe incontinence.
